summary.text: Product-minded software engineer with a decade of experience building dependable developer platforms, accessible tools, and data-intensive services.
Known for connecting customer needs to measurable engineering outcomes while mentoring teams through complex technical changes.

bullets.text: Led a six-engineer initiative to replace a brittle deployment pipeline with a versioned platform API, reducing median service onboarding from three days to under four hours across 42 teams.
Designed service ownership and progressive-delivery controls adopted by 18 production groups; incident review showed a 31% decrease in release-related rollback events over two quarters.
Partnered with design and accessibility specialists to replace keyboard-inaccessible deployment forms, then added automated checks that blocked regressions before release.
Mentored four engineers through project planning, production ownership, and technical presentations; two later led independent platform improvements.
Built a TypeScript and PostgreSQL ingestion service processing 2.4 million partner records per day, with idempotent retries and per-source quality reports for operations staff.
Profiled and redesigned the largest customer search queries, cutting p95 response latency from 820 ms to 290 ms without removing filters or reducing result accuracy.
Coordinated a zero-downtime migration of 640 GB of event data, documenting rollback conditions and validating representative records with the analytics team before cutover.
Maintained internal build tools and shared libraries used by 35 developers, improving error messages and adding documentation for the most common local setup failures.
Worked with support and product colleagues to reproduce customer defects, write regression tests, and ship small, reviewable fixes on a weekly release schedule.

Implemented a queue-backed report generation service with bounded concurrency and explicit retry limits, reducing staff wait time while keeping customer-facing API requests responsive during end-of-quarter workloads.
Collaborated with product operations to make scheduled exports resumable after process restarts, recording each job's state transitions and protecting completed reports from duplicate delivery.
Added integration coverage for malformed input, interrupted workers, and oversized attachments, then wrote an on-call guide with safe retry and recovery steps.
Created a small open-source dashboard that joins traces, deploy metadata, and ownership records so on-call engineers can move from a service alert to its recent change history.
Published setup guides and sample data that let contributors run the project without access to production systems or private customer information.
Developed a local readiness check that inspects build metadata, service ownership, and staged deployment configuration before an approval request, with clear output for engineers and reviewers.
Kept validation rules deterministic and inspectable, separating advisory warnings from blocking conditions so teams could address release risks without hiding deployment failures.
Published synthetic example configurations and recovery notes that let contributors exercise the tool offline without credentials or access to production systems.
